target.title: fix(skills): surface skill source shadowing
target.body:
﻿Closes #100071

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users could have a workspace skill silently replace a same-named plugin, bundled, managed, or agent skill without any visible signal in skill discovery, the CLI, Control UI, or doctor lint.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the existing documented precedence behavior, but records lower-precedence same-name skill sources as shadow metadata on the active skill. The metadata is surfaced in load-time warnings, `openclaw skills list` / `openclaw skills info`, Control UI skill cards/details, and the skills-readiness doctor lint check. This intentionally does not add a fail-closed `denyShadowing` config surface because that compatibility/security policy still needs maintainer product/security direction.

## User Impact

Operators can now see when an active skill is overriding another skill source and inspect the shadowed paths before deciding whether the override is intentional. Existing intentional overrides continue to work.

## Evidence

- Current head: `80c9a64ee0dc0c7aaea4aad11c21ab64126b615c`.
- Claim proved: same-name lower-precedence skill sources are retained as shadow metadata and surfaced through CLI list/info and doctor lint; the current-head lint blocker is fixed.
- Changed files:
  - `src/skills/loading/workspace.ts`
  - `src/skills/discovery/status.ts`
  - `src/cli/skills-cli.format.ts`
  - `src/commands/doctor-skills-core.ts`
  - `src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts`
  - `src/flows/doctor-core-checks.runtime.ts`
  - `ui/src/pages/skills/view.ts`
  - focused tests for the touched surfaces
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `git diff --check` -> passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/loading/workspace-precedence.test.ts src/skills/discovery/status.test.ts src/cli/skills-cli.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.e2e.test.ts` -> passed 3 Vitest shards, 64 tests passed, 1 skipped, on earlier head `92945133b3db90910b6f43b76f63c90b9f43459e`.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/skills-cli.test.ts` -> passed on current repair head, 1 shard / 27 tests.
  - Real CLI proof with isolated temporary `OPENCLAW_HOME`, `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and workspace: a workspace `shadow-demo` skill shadowed a lower-precedence managed `shadow-demo` skill. `openclaw skills list` showed `openclaw-workspace (shadows: openclaw-managed)`, and `openclaw skills info shadow-demo` showed a `Shadows:` section with the managed skill path.
  - Real doctor proof: `openclaw doctor --lint --only core/doctor/skills-readiness --json` exited 1 as expected for warning-level lint findings and included `shadow-demo from openclaw-workspace shadows lower-precedence skill source(s): openclaw-managed.`
  - Commit hook oxfmt ran on the original 15 staged files before the lint follow-up: `Finished in 1309ms on 15 files using 20 threads.`
  - Autoreview local mode completed with exit code 0 on the original implementation.
- Observed result:
  - The `check-lint` finding in `src/cli/skills-cli.format.ts` is fixed by using `lines.push(theme.muted("  Shadows:"));` instead of an unnecessary template expression.
  - The CLI status record includes `source: "openclaw-workspace"` and `shadows[0].source: "openclaw-managed"` for the active skill.
  - Human CLI output exposes both the shadow summary and the shadowed path.
  - Doctor lint reports the shadowing warning without repairing it.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - Control UI screenshot proof is still not gathered in this local worktree because the available UI dependency tree is missing `@openclaw/uirouter`; `ui/src/pages/skills/view.test.ts` and a minimal jsdom render fail before rendering. The changed UI behavior is covered by the added rendering test and should run in CI's hydrated dependency environment.
  - Maintainer policy decision remains: whether this visibility-only hardening should merge with a default doctor warning and whether the linked issue should close without a fail-closed `denyShadowing` policy.
